    # Concatenate all DataFrames vertically (union all)
    combined_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Ensure the column is integer type as per target schema
    combined_df['zip_code'] = combined_df['zip_code'].astype(int)

    # The target table schema is just ['zip_code'], so no further transformation needed

    combined_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_52/target_multisource_cot.csv", index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
